rubric.description: Assess the recorded interpretation and acceptance sequence, not the prototype implementation or its flow verification. Before recording final acceptance, present what production must match and what may change and obtain explicit confirmation. Preserve the confirmed required and flexible details in the decision notes. Keep the selected runnable source and retain the alternative with a clear statement that it is not selected for production. Do not require a particular reply format or literal rejection word.

examples.request: I want the dialog for production. Keep the item summary, editable invalid-name feedback and save/cancel behavior. Sample items and colors can change.

commands.output:
# Production selection

Dialog selected. The dialog keeps the item name and quantity visible above its name field at laptop and phone widths. Invalid names show feedback while remaining editable. Save updates the name; Cancel keeps the old name. Sample items and colors may change.
Inline is rejected for production and remains runnable at prototypes/inline.html.
Runnable dialog: prototypes/dialog.html.
Recorded the selection and required behavior in [decision notes](docs/decision.md). The production destination is still open.
Confirmed. The dialog layout and those editing rules are the requirements; sample items and colors remain flexible.

# Confirmed production requirements

Dialog accepted after confirmation. The dialog keeps the item name and quantity visible above its name field at laptop and phone widths. Invalid names show feedback while remaining editable. Save updates the name; Cancel keeps the old name. Sample items and colors may change.
Inline is rejected for production and remains runnable at prototypes/inline.html.
Runnable dialog: prototypes/dialog.html.
